text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

2. Adoption hinged on trust. Reps used it only after we clarified who could see transcripts and how long we kept them.

3. Customers rarely objected. Asking permission upfront took ten seconds and built goodwill.

4. Summaries missed nuance. Tone, hesitation, and side comments still needed a human ear.

5. Managers coached better. Listening to real call snippets beat relying on rep recaps.

The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It removed admin so reps could focus on the conversation.

What would you want from an AI note-taker in your sales process?
